experience.title: Pilates + Buenos Aires
experience.lead: Visiting Buenos Aires, or planning your trip?
body: Between cafes, restaurants, shopping, long walks and late nights, make room for a moment of wellbeing too.
We are two blocks from Don Julio, next door to El Preferido de Palermo, and a short walk from the Botanical Garden, Plaza Serrano, Distrito Arcos and La Rural.
{minutes} minutes of Reformer Pilates, groups of up to {max} people and a *boutique experience* in the heart of Palermo Soho.
experience.note: You do not need to be a Studio124 member or live in the city

about.title: Studio124 is your place to pause, reconnect and grow stronger from the inside out
about.text: We are a space designed to reconnect body and mind through mindful movement. You will find a warm, calm environment where every class becomes a moment of pause, balance and wellbeing, because whole-body work adapted to you gives you back control of your body.

method.title: Reformer Pilates
method.subtitle: What is it?
method.text: It is a discipline that combines strength, flexibility, postural control and breathing on a bed (the reformer) built specifically to get the most out of every exercise. Through mindful, guided work it improves posture, tones the body, increases mobility and releases tension. It is an ideal method to build strength from the inside out. Classes are in groups of up to {max} people, so we can watch every movement you make and follow your progress at your own pace.

membership.title: Want to come regularly?
body: We also offer packs of {packs} classes, to be used within a {weeks}-week period.
You do not have to wait for the start of the month: _you can begin your membership whenever you like_, and your {weeks} weeks start from that moment.
To hear the prices, pick the frequency that suits you best and set your regular time slots, message us on WhatsApp and book your membership. We will help you find the right option for your routine.

items.question: What age can I start at?
items.answer: From {age} years old you are very welcome!

items.question: Is Pilates a rehabilitation method?
items.answer: No. Pilates helps prevent injuries and improve mobility, but it does not replace medical rehabilitation.

items.question: What if I have an injury?
items.answer: You can train! As long as you are not in acute pain and your doctor has cleared you.

items.question: Can I do Pilates while pregnant?
items.answer: Absolutely! As long as your obstetrician agrees. It is best to start from the third month.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Comfortable clothes, ideally close-fitting. Please avoid anything with zips or metal details!

items.question: Is Pilates only for women?
items.answer: Not at all! It is a complete workout for anyone, whatever their gender.
